usdRate.sourceName: Bank of Albania, official exchange rate
usdRate.note: ALL 81.16 per USD (ALL 90.90 per EUR) on 30 Oct 2026; 81.12 on 2 Nov 2026. World Bank 2025 average 86.80. Prices are written with 'L' or 'Lekë'.

inflation_cpi.note: Annual CPI 2.9% in September 2026 (2.4% a year earlier); published 8 October 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Bank of Albania 3% inflation target; CPI 2.9% (Sep 2026), 2.1% (2025, World Bank)
inflation_projection.note: The Bank of Albania targets 3% CPI inflation and recent inflation has run close to it, so the target is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank of Albania, interest rates (base rate, one-week repo)
policy_rate.note: Base rate 2.50% since 9 July 2025, kept unchanged at the 7 October 2026 meeting (Trading Economics).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Bank of Albania, lek deposit rates offered by banks (comparison table)
savings_account_rate.note: Demand/savings deposits in lek pay typically 0.1-0.7% at banks (range 0.03-3%); the central bank average on household overnight lek deposits was only 0.05% in September 2026.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Bank of Albania, lek deposit rates offered by banks (comparison table)
fdr_3m_rate.note: 3-month lek time deposits typically 0.3-0.7% for standard tiers; midpoint used.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Albania, lek deposit rates offered by banks (comparison table)
fdr_1y_rate.note: 12-month lek time deposits typically 1.0-1.4% for standard tiers in the July 2026 comparison; the central bank average on new household lek deposits up to 1 year was 1.40% in September 2026 (interest rate statistics, Table 3.1).

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found in the Bank of Albania deposit rate comparison.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Bank of Albania, interest rate statistics (new lek time deposits of households)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average rate on new household lek time deposits, September 2026 (preliminary; time-series file 'Statistikat e normave te interesit, Seri kohore, Shtator 2026', Table 3.1); up to 1 year 1.40%. Outstanding household lek overnight deposits paid 0.05%. World Bank FR.INR.DPST 1.86% (2024).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Albania, 5-year benchmark yield fixing and bond auction results
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Individuals can buy government securities at Bank of Albania desks or licensed institutions; the 5-year fixed-coupon bond fixed at 5.10% on 30 Oct 2026 and the 20 Oct 2026 auction accepted 5.10-5.45%. There is no separate savings certificate.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Bank of Albania, treasury bill auction results
tbill_91d_rate.note: Weighted average yield of the 3-month T-bill auction no. 2102 on 6 October 2026; the 12-month bill yielded 3.06% on 27 October 2026.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Albania, daily benchmark yield fixing (5Y)
tbond_5y_rate.note: 5-year benchmark fixing 5.10% (3-year 4.51%, 4-year 4.66% the same day); unchanged on 2 Nov 2026. The 20 Oct 2026 5-year auction accepted 5.10-5.45%.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Bank of Albania auction pages showed only the latest 3-, 5- and 7-year auctions (7-year 5.25% on 12 Oct 2026); no recent 10-year yield was found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Albania, taxes on personal income
tax_bank_interest.note: Investment income other than dividends (8%) is taxed at 15%, withheld at source.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Albania, taxes on personal income
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Government securities interest falls under other investment income at 15%; no exemption is listed for it.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: ALL 2,500,000 per depositor per bank, regardless of number of deposits or currency.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: Bank of Albania, maximum APR for consumer credit
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Legal maximum APR for lek credit cards (0-200,000 lek) from 17 July 2026; 24.46% for euro cards.

equity_return_low.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (ALL per USD 86.8 in 2025); Bank of Albania rate 81.16 on 30 Oct 2026
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund in lek terms if world shares are weak and the lek keeps appreciating; there is no meaningful local stock market.

equity_return_base.sourceName: 12-month T-bill 3.06% less 15% tax = 2.6%; global equity in lek terms
equity_return_base.note: Albania has no liquid local equity market, so the base case is a global index in lek terms, kept within 4 points of the 2.6% after-tax safe rate because the lek has appreciated.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run record; World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF
equity_return_high.note: High case near long-run global equity returns with a stable lek.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (ALL per USD 86.8 in 2025, 81.2 in Oct 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and a further stronger lek.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (ALL per USD 86.8 in 2025, 81.2 in Oct 2026)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% less a slight lek appreciation trend against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (ALL per USD 86.8 in 2025, 81.2 in Oct 2026)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a stable or weaker lek.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Albania deposit rate table: 12-month lek deposits 1.0-1.4%, less 15% tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bank term deposits after 15% tax.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: rolling 12-month treasury bills bought by individuals, after tax.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 5-year government bonds held to maturity after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Financial Supervisory Authority (AMF) site refused automated access and no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold mainly with bank loans; no published per-1,000 premium rates by age were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay in Albania was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age band were found.

oop_health_share.note: 2023 figure, the latest World Bank value (older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: INSTAT CPI September 2026 (health group contributed +0.06 points); 3% target
goal_inflation_health.note: INSTAT does not publish the health group's annual rate in the release, so we plan with the 3% projection plus one point for private medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: INSTAT CPI September 2026 (education services +1.2% in the month); 3% target
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices rise in steps each school year, so we plan with the 3% projection plus one point.

life_expectancy.note: Men 77.9, women 81.6. 2024 figure, the latest World Bank value (older than 2025).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 26.8 (2025, World Bank), 40.4 (2040) and 77.2 (2065, populationpyramid.net/albania/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Law 7703 on Social Insurance (ISSH consolidated text 2023), Art. 92
retirement_age_default.note: Under Law 7703 Art. 92 (as amended by Law 104/2014) the pension age is 65 for men in 2026 (women 62), rising by one month a year from 2033 for men (two months a year for women) until both reach 67 in 2056. Anyone born after 1975 retires at between 65 years 9 months (born 1976) and 67 (born 1989 or later), so 67 is used for planning. 40 years of insurance for a full pension from 2029, 15 years minimum.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Law 7703 on Social Insurance (ISSH consolidated text 2023), Art. 92
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants follow the same social insurance pension age (no separate general retirement age for government employees was found): 65 for men in 2026, rising to 67 by 2056; 67 applies to anyone born from 1989 and is used for planning.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: bank term deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at the after-tax 12-month treasury bill rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of 3- to 5-year government bonds after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: 12-month T-bill after tax 2.6%; global equity in lek terms
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag and the lek keeps rising.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: 12-month T-bill after tax 2.6%; 5-year bond 5.1%; global equity base 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: about half global equity at 6% and half lek government bonds at about 3.5-4% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Social pension ALL 10,222 a month from 1 July 2026 (Council of Ministers Decision No. 497 of 26.06.2026); reduced by any other income.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Age 70, resident in Albania for the last 5 years, not entitled to a contributory pension, and no income or income below the social pension.

gratuity_rule.note: The Albanian Labour Code provides a seniority payment when employment ends, but its text could not be read (ILO NATLEX and EPLex refused automated access, and web search was unavailable to the verifier), so the days per year of service and the conditions are not confirmed.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Law 7703 on Social Insurance (ISSH consolidated text 2023), Art. 31, 61, 92
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory pay-as-you-go social insurance pension (ISSH): pension age 65 for men and 62 for women in 2026, rising to 67 for both by 2056 (Art. 92), so 67 for someone born after 1975; minimum 15 years of insurance; pensions are indexed every year for price changes (Art. 61); social insurance income is exempt from personal income tax (PwC).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No separate savings certificate; individuals buy treasury bills and bonds at Bank of Albania desks or licensed institutions.

tbill_91d.note: Individuals may bid at the auctions.

tbond_10y.note: Issued occasionally; no recent auction found.

equity_fund.note: Retail investment funds supervised by the Financial Supervisory Authority exist but mostly hold bonds; there is no liquid local stock market, so diversified equity exposure is mainly through foreign funds.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold was found.

insuranceRegulator.name: Financial Supervisory Authority (Autoriteti i Mbikëqyrjes Financiare)

insuranceComplaints.name: Financial Supervisory Authority (AMF) complaints
insuranceComplaints.note: Complaints about insurers go to the AMF; its site refused automated access, so the exact page was not checked.

pensionScheme.name: Social Insurance Institute (Instituti i Sigurimeve Shoqërore) – old-age pension

depositInsurance.name: Deposit Insurance Agency (Agjencia e Sigurimit të Depozitave)
